description: Index of all relevant features, classes, entities, components, and contracts defined in the GPWCF Primary Architecture Step/SPU Level domain documents. Links are relative to this index file location.

records.name: SPU Functional Binding
records.description: Wave 3 detailed design (artifact 1) defining how a concrete Step Processing Unit is functionally bound to Prefect's native execution model while preserving the SPU as the actual domain processing entity, its specialized callable/result contract, and Step Composition ownership of invocation coordination and Step-level flow.

records.name: Step Processing Unit (SPU) Entity
records.description: The actual specialized processing unit that performs one assigned processing responsibility inside its owning Step. Not a delegation-only wrapper and not the Step Aggregate.

records.name: StepProcessingUnit[TInput,TOutput]
records.description: Generic callable contract of the SPU; each concrete SPU binds TInput and TOutput to the types required by its own Step responsibility. No common concrete input or output type across Steps is imposed.

records.name: TInput Type Parameter
records.description: The SPU-specific input type accepted by this processing unit and supplied by Step Composition.

records.name: TOutput Type Parameter
records.description: The SPU-specific processing artifact type that this processing unit may produce and carry in its invocation result.

records.name: execute Logical Operation
records.description: Signature execute(input: TInput) -> SPUExecutionResult[TOutput]; one logical input value supplied for this SPU invocation, returning the structured aggregate result for this invocation.

records.name: Invocation Unit / Execution Attempt
records.description: One invocation of execute represents one execution attempt of the Step Processing Unit.

records.name: SPU Input Contract
records.description: The supplied input must conform to the concrete SPU's TInput type; the generic contract does not prescribe internal structure, ownership model, mutability, lifetime, or pass-by semantics of TInput.

records.name: SPU Output Contract
records.description: Return SPUExecutionResult[TOutput] for a normally completed invocation, preserving results and evidence assigned to this SPU's invocation contract; the SPU does not assemble StepExecutionResult or decide the Step's next flow transition.

records.name: SPU Error Type Definition Registration
records.description: Each concrete SPU defines and registers its own SPUErrorTypeDefinition instances through the SPUErrorTypeDefinitionRegistry instance assigned to it by the Pipeline.

records.name: SPU Error Occurrence Creation
records.description: The SPU creates SPUError occurrences for errors arising within its own processing responsibility and makes them available to the owning Step Composition.

records.name: Step Composition - SPU Caller Relationship
records.description: The concrete owning Step Composition selects and invokes the SPU, supplies its specialized input/dependencies, and consumes SPUExecutionResult; owns internal composition and flow decisions involving the SPU.

records.name: SPU Functional Prefect Binding - Native Task
records.description: Each bounded SPU invocation maps to a native Prefect Task inside its owning Step Subworkflow; Prefect executes the Task while Step Composition remains authoritative for invocation meaning, permitted conditions, and result flow impact.

records.name: SPU Entity versus Prefect Task versus Prefect Task Run
records.description: The deliberate distinction among SPU Entity (domain processing entity), SPU callable implementation, Prefect Task (native execution element), and Prefect Task Run (operational record).

records.name: SPU Identity and Invocation Correlation
records.description: SPU identity and invocation correlation are maintained across the Step Subworkflow boundary; SPU and invocation identities remain distinct from Step/Stage and native runtime identities.

records.name: SPUExecutionResult Mapping and Preservation
records.description: The binding returns the exact SPUExecutionResult without replacing it with Prefect State; SPU constructs and returns the structured result consumed by Step Composition.

records.name: Structured Results versus Exceptions versus Prefect Operational State
records.description: Separation of returned structured results, thrown exceptions, and Prefect operational State; exceptions that prevent SPUExecutionResult return are not an SPUExecutionResult.

records.name: SPUExecutionResult Contract
records.description: Design-baseline contract (documentId: pipeline.spu-execution-result.contract) defining the structured result returned by one normally completed SPU invocation to its owning Step Composition; architectural level: step-component, owning level: Step.

records.name: SPUExecutionResult[TOutput]
records.description: Structured aggregate result produced by StepProcessingUnit[TInput,TOutput] and consumed by the owning Step Composition; carries the processing artifact and SPU-invocation-scoped structured results/evidence.

records.name: processingArtifact Element
records.description: Optional[TOutput] element produced by the concrete SPU; the artifact produced by this SPU invocation, not automatically the Step's final TOutput.

records.name: spuErrorOccurrences Element
records.description: Optional[Collection[SPUError[TErrorOccurrenceContext]]] element; original SPUError occurrences created by this SPU for errors within its own processing responsibility, each preserving occurrence identity and error-type-definition reference.

records.name: validatorResult Element
records.description: Optional[SPUValidatorResult] element; validation result associated with this SPU invocation when the Step's design assigns validation to this SPU scope; independently optional.

records.name: TErrorOccurrenceContext Type Parameter
records.description: The SPU-specialized context type carried by SPUError occurrences made available in this SPU invocation result, when applicable; selected by the concrete SPU.

records.name: Result Elements Optionality Rule
records.description: All elements are independently optional; absence is not a success/failure status. Absence means the corresponding value was not included; the concrete Step defines applicability and interpretation.

records.name: SPUExecutionResult Preservation Invariant
records.description: Every result element actually produced and available under the SPU invocation contract must be preserved in the returned SPUExecutionResult; a later internal failure must not discard an earlier result the contract requires to be returned.

records.name: SPUExecutionResult Exception Boundary
records.description: An exception that prevents execute from returning is not an SPUExecutionResult; no universal conversion from exceptions to SPUError occurrences or structured result elements is imposed.

records.name: SPUExecutionResult Assembly Rules
records.description: The SPU assembles only its own invocation-level result; does not assemble StepExecutionResult or decide the Step's next flow transition; Step Composition consumes returned values and performs cross-SPU or Step-level aggregation.
